name: Mutilation raises Gore, Infernal Strike and Sever damage by 10/20/30% per rank (#3550)
contract: Mutilation reads 'Increases the damage of Gore and Sever by 10%' at rank 1 (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description, which omits the conditional third target). The client's full description (spell.csv.gz) actually names all three: 'Increases the damage of Gore, Infernal Strike, and Brimstone Bludgeon (Shieldgore) [Sever] by $s1%.' The decoded Spell.dbc capture shows ranks 805695/807900/807913 each carry a single effect: aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 9/19/29 (+1 from DieSides 1 = 10/20/30), SpellClassMask (0,2097728,0). Decoding that dword1 value: bit 6 (64) matches Gore's (680939-680944/805555) own family flags, bit 9 (512) matches Infernal Strike's (501511-501520/801016), and bit 21 (2097152) matches Sever's (500904/501499-501507) - the exact combined bits already used elsewhere in this file (Combusting Blade's 'Infernal Strike' SPELLMOD_COST classmask flag96(0,768,0) documents bit 9; Chop Shop's flag96(0,2097152|8388608,0) documents bit 21). The native classmask already covers all three named abilities at their stated per-rank percentages; nothing in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp touches 805695/807900/807913, so no functional change is needed - this scenario is a regression proof. At level 60 the owned ranks are Gore 680944, Infernal Strike 501518, Sever 501505 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h). Only rank 1 (805695, +10%) is exercised directly; ranks 2/3 share the identical mechanism and are confirmed against the same capture in the commit body.
